spanish: Y verá la plaga, y he aquí la plaga en paredes de la casa, hundimientos verdosos o rojizos, y su apariencia baja desde la pared.

findings.issue: מַרְאֵיהֶן is parsed as a masculine plural noun plus a 3fp suffix; «apariencia» is singular and drops that plurality.
שָׁפָל is a stative adjective and מִן is only the preposition from/than; «baja desde» is readily read as the verb bajar plus a source, which adds descent and closes the comparative.

notes: verá, the repeated plaga, walls of the house, greenish or reddish depressions, and the singular definite wall match the tokens.
